hebrewText: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י הוֹלֵךְ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם בְּ/דֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֞ם בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֣ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֗ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא נָפַל֩ דָּבָ֨ר אֶחָ֜ד מִ/כֹּ֣ל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הַ/טּוֹבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶם֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/כֹּל֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ/כֶ֔ם לֹֽא נָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ דָּבָ֥ר אֶחָֽד

tokens.bdb: lo!
tokens.kjv: behold, lo, see.

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.

As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
